definitions.short: Jehallelel , the name of two Israelites
definitions.full: H3094. Yehallelel יְהַלֶּלְאֵל proper name [masculine] ( he shall praise God , compare מַהֲלַלְאֵל below); — 1 a man of Judah 1Chr 4:16 ; 2 a Levite 2Chr 29:12 .

occurrences.englishText: The sons of Jehallelel: Ziph, Ziphah, Tiria, and Asarel.

Then the Levites arose, Mahath, the son of Amasai, and Joel the son of Azariah, of the sons of the Kohathites; and of the sons of Merari, Kish the son of Abdi, and Azariah the son of Jehallelel; and of the Gershonites, Joah the son of Zimmah, and Eden the son of Joah;
